facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: €500K commitment at inception for companies Antler decides to back
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Decision typically within weeks while building with Antler
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Current Europe page states €500K typically converts into ~10% at €5M valuation; €200K wired immediately at inception, with remainder structured/follow-on per current terms.
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Join appropriate European location and have necessary visa documentation to enter/stay.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 有明确创业团队/项目，能说明产品、市场和团队；公司阶段应处于早期，通常不应已明显超出 seed 阶段
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Antler ONE / Continental Europe includes a Berlin kickoff then local work with Berlin/Amsterdam/Munich teams.
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes, if able to participate legally in chosen European location
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Pre-seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司

facts.Funding / Support: €500K commitment at inception for companies Antler decides to back
facts.Funding Trigger: Decision typically within weeks while building with Antler
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Current Europe page states €500K typically converts into ~10% at €5M valuation; €200K wired immediately at inception, with remainder structured/follow-on per current terms.
facts.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Join appropriate European location and have necessary visa documentation to enter/stay.
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: An identifiable team or project with a clear explanation of its product, market and founders; The company should be early-stage, generally no later than seed

facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Pre-seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration
